integrity: All-parameter proof is analytic; 1,000 numerical phase tests and exact rational polynomial checks are finite corroboration, not independent certification. Bibliographic equivalence risk remains.
scientific_limitations: Exact orbit count is restricted to regular levels of the zero-phase-sum invariant leaf; not a classification of all leaves or nonzero frequencies. Full separatrix connections and persistence are not claimed.
title: A two-to-one periodic-orbit transition in a conservative Winfree triad
